notes.title: Nudist Beach Survival Simulator Remastered is on the way!
notes.content:
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/708640/Nudist_Beach_Survival_Simulator/?curator_clanid=33872549]Nudist Beach Survival Simulator[/url][/b] will be re-created on Unreal Engine 4! Changing the engine is primarily to fix all minor bugs in the game and add new content.

By default, the new version of the game will be included:
[list]
[*] New gameplay modes
[*] More settings 
[*] Full controller support
[*] New Steam achievements
[*] Steam Cloud support
[/list]

Expected premiere date: [b]fourth quarter 2020[/b]

Stay tuned!
